label: Dry curd cottage cheese
note: Washed curd without the cream dressing

about.text: Cottage cheese of washed curd grains with no cream dressing, so under 0.5 % milkfat. The US standard of identity allows at most 80 % moisture and requires skimmed-milk ingredients.

facts.v: Phosphoric, lactic, citric or hydrochloric acid to pH 4.5–4.7; set while heated to at most 49 °C without stirring; cut, drained, washed, drained again
Food acid and glucono-delta-lactone to final pH 4.5–4.8, held until set; cut, drained, washed, drained
Rennet or another milk-clotting enzyme allowed with any route
May be pressed, chilled, worked and salted; no cream dressing is added, which is what separates it from creamed cottage cheese
